messages:
Elena (CS): Customer at acme-inc reports repeated 503s from Redwood API since 01:12 UTC. They also noticed missing audit entries for key operations between 00:50-01:10. They're asking if their keys were compromised and want immediate mitigation.
Anya (Support): Can you DM me the request IDs and customer org ID? I'll pull logs.
Elena (CS): Sent in DM. sample req ids: r-9a3f2c, r-9a3f2d, r-9a3f2e. Org: acme-inc-prod. Customer shared screenshot: "error: 503 Service Unavailable" and audit list showing gap.
Sam (SRE): Looking at the API gateway — we had a brief autoscaler kink at 00:58 but it recovered. No platform-wide HSM errors in metrics, but I'm seeing increased latency on the KMS proxy for us-west-2 around 00:50-01:15.
Priya (Security): There's an external CVE advisory circulating for vendor-crypto v2.7.3 that affects HSM firmware. Has anyone confirmed matching firmware versions in our hosted HSM pool or private deployments?
Tom (DevOps): We're tracking HSM firmware across clusters. Quick query shows two dedicated HSMs in us-west-2 on fw v2.7.3 (candidate). I'll validate and isolate them.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: canary/hotfix/kms-fallback @ 01:42 UTC by Tom
Anya (Support): Customer wants an ETA for a fix or mitigation. They asked if we can rotate envelope keys for their org just for peace of mind.
Sam (SRE): Short-term mitigation options: 1) Route acme-inc to software-based KMS fallback (increased CPU cost) 2) Rotate envelope keys + rewrap with new master key (requires KMS availability) 3) Temporarily disable cross-region key wrapping for their org.
Priya (Security): Prioritize: confirm whether private HSMs are affected. If firmware matches CVE, we treat as high severity. Isolation + key rotation recommended. We should also prepare a CVE notification for customers and regulator list.
Elena (CS): Acme asks for immediate rotation. They want to know if any ciphertext could have been decrypted externally.
Tom (DevOps): For rotation, here's a quick rewrap command we can run per-org (safe path):
```
# rewrap envelope key for org
redwood-kms rewrap --org acme-inc-prod --from-key alias/master-old --to-key alias/master-new --confirm
```
This will queue rewrap jobs. If KMS_unavailable, fallback to software path.
Sam (SRE): I'm starting the route-to-software fallback for acme-inc-prod now (us-west-2). Will monitor for error reduction. Update in ~10m.
Priya (Security): Also recommend we suspend any automated log truncation jobs for the timeframe so we preserve raw audit chain. Legal should be aware.
Legal (Marcos): Noted. Please cc me on customer communication drafts. We may want to mention we're investigating potential exposure but don't assert compromise until validated.
Anya (Support): Drafted a short message to acme: "We're investigating increased KMS latency and missing audit entries. We're routing you to a temporary fallback and can perform a key rotation on request. We'll share a timeline within 4 hours." Client approved to send.
Elena (CS): Sent to customer at 01:47 UTC. They replied: "Please rotate keys now and notify our security team. We need an ETA for rollback if issues continue."
Sam (SRE): Canary rollback/patch in progress. First canary nodes patched and serving fallback. No errors on canary in the last 120s. Proceeding to staged rollout across affected HSMs.
Tom (DevOps): Rolling firmware isolate for fw v2.7.3 nodes: taking one HSM out of rotation -> snapshot logs -> repro attempt -> proceed. If rewraps fail, we have manual decrypt/re-encrypt fallback (requires customer consent).
Priya (Security): Action items: A) Confirm firmware list across all HSMs B) Complete per-org rewrap for acme-inc C) Prepare CVE disclosure/mitigation KB D) Pause log truncation for window.
Anya (Support): If we do rewraps, coordinate with Customer Success so they can notify customers' security contacts and schedule the rewrap during low traffic.
Sam (SRE): Update: software KMS fallback reduced 503s for acme by ~90%, latency stabilized. Will continue rollout. Next update 02:15 UTC.
Elena (CS): Customer sent their security contact info. They want a signed attestation after rotation. We'll queue that.
Priya (Security): I'll draft the attestation template. Keep incident channel updated.
Tom (DevOps): Canary rollout complete, proceeding to 25% nodes. No abnormal telemetry so far.
Anya (Support): Thanks all. Customer currently satisfied with fallback but wants concrete ETA for full rotation and CVE patch timeline.
Priya (Security): Patch ETA: we can push hotfix for hosted HSM routing logic within 6 hours; full firmware remediations depend on vendor timelines but we have mitigation path (rewrap + software fallback) now.
Legal (Marcos): Keep customer comms conservative. No admission of breach. Provide mitigation steps and offer SOC2/forensic data if requested.
Sam (SRE): Last note: preserving audit logs and handing them to Security for forensic analysis now. Starting secure export at 02:05 UTC.
Elena (CS): Closing loop with customer: "Rotation started, we enabled fallback and will update within 4 hours." They'll escalate again if anything changes. :thumbsup:
